notes: Ethereum launch of Worker Frens (wFREN), 2222 on-chain pixel frens, from the accepted sources unchanged. Order: PlaceFrens (src/FrensPlacement.sol, no arguments), WorkerArt1 and WorkerArt2 (src/art/WorkerArt.sol, no arguments), then PlaceModules (src/FrensPlacement.sol) with (PlaceFrens placed, address art1, address art2) = $contract:PlaceFrens, $contract:WorkerArt1, $contract:WorkerArt2. PlaceFrens creates FrenPrices and IMD6900Frens (named Worker Frens). WorkerArt1 and WorkerArt2 hold the new art (the artist's coat, item06, 12 backgrounds and the palettes) as code in which every byte is PUSH data. PlaceModules creates FrenSwapper, FrenMinter, FrenWorkerGate (the workers' and WL gate) and WorkerFrensRenderer, which reads the two new art contracts and the swarm's FrenArtChunk1..7 already on Ethereum. PlaceModules reverts with PlaceFailed unless WorkerArt1 and WorkerArt2 have exactly the code hashes recorded in WorkerArtIndex, so the art arguments cannot be swapped or replaced. Placement: collection, prices, swapper, minter and gate are created through the standard CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C with the creation code in src/FrensCode.sol and the salts in src/FrensPlan.sol, so the collection is 0x69006841041E7519fbE54BfF3F506FBDCAbabF09 and the swapper 0x6900d1D4BcF96143C6013AF72F319Ad401e7928a regardless of who deploys. If a planned address already holds that exact code, it is used as is. A pre-placed swapper is accepted only if its price average is within 2x of the pool's current price. Otherwise PlaceModules creates its own with a plain CREATE, and that swapper is the one wired in (PlaceModules.swapper()). The renderer's address follows from the art contracts (PlaceModules.renderer()). Where the CREATE2 deployer does not exist (a fresh chain), the launch creates the same contracts with its own CREATE2, wired the same way, and calls nothing that existed before it. Roles: the team wallet 0x35dA9C0303507ddf708E87F2568EdDf12c47a059 (FrensPlan.OWNER, fixed in the source) is the collection's owner and governor and the gate's owner. The collection also receives the swarm's keeper and relayer from FrensPlan. No constructor takes an owner argument, so $owner is not used, and the launch contracts and the factory keep no role. Deployment sends no ETH and makes no initialization calls. After the launch, the team wallet runs script/frens/DeployFrens.s.sol setup() to wire the frens to PlaceModules.renderer(). That owner action is separate and is not part of this manifest.
